## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, Prettier, tests)
- [ ] Added/updated tests in `test/e2e.mjs` for behaviour changes
- [ ] If `spec/` or `scripts/` changed: ran `npm run generate` and committed the regenerated files
- [ ] Updated `README.md` for user-facing changes (env vars, tools, setup)
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`fix: …`, `feat: …`); the changelog is generated from it
